record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: mask-form switch on shield depletion (OnShieldDepletedEffect) plus a passive-keyed branch inside the IVY_CUDGEL ability
record.summary: Passive.OGERPON_CORNERSTONE has one PassiveEffects entry, an OnShieldDepletedEffect created by ogerponMaskDropEffect, and the rest of its behaviour lives in a passive-keyed branch of the IVY_CUDGEL ability (the Passive is also referenced in the ability file and the item-drop code). Units OGERPON_CORNERSTONE and OGERPON_CORNERSTONE_MASK are both 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 1, GRASS + ROCK with the same stats; the MASK form holds the CORNERSTONE_MASK item (declared SHIELD 100 and DEF 10) and the plain form does not. When the masked unit's shield is depleted, the entity is renamed to OGERPON_CORNERSTONE and the mask item is removed from the entity. On every IVY_CUDGEL cast (both forms): the target takes the ability hit (100 at 3 stars, special damage), every adjacent enemy gets FLINCH 5000 ms (blocked by Rune Protect; duration reductions are read from the caster because the call passes the caster, not the target, as the status owner argument), and the caster gains PROTECT for round(1000 x (2 + AP/100)) ms, with a crit factor of 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5. Protect blocks incoming damage, so the shield cannot be depleted while it lasts; it is not given if the caster is enraged or already protected. Requested amounts are labelled as such; no gameplay claims.
triggers: OnShieldDepletedEffect: the shield reaches 0 after a hit or a negative addShield
IVY_CUDGEL cast: branch keyed on pokemon.passive

effects.declaredRaw: CORNERSTONE_MASK declares SHIELD 100 and DEF 10; when the shield is depleted the MASK form reverts to OGERPON_CORNERSTONE
effects.scaling: none; shield requested = 100 via addShield(100, self, 0, false)
effects.resolution: requested shield 100; applied by addShield: enraged halves a positive shield, Math.round; DEF 10 goes through the defense adder (section I of core-mechanics.md). On depletion (hit with shield part >= shield, or negative addShield bringing it to 0) the effect sets entity name/index to OGERPON_CORNERSTONE and removes the mask item from the entity; the stat bonuses already applied are not reversed in the code read

effects.declaredRaw: IVY_CUDGEL hit on the target: 100 at 3 stars (table 50 / 75 / 100 / 200)
effects.scaling: handleSpecialDamage default apBoost; crit flag from the cast
effects.resolution: requested 100 (3 stars); not applied if the target is protected / skydiving / magic-bouncing; otherwise defended by SPE_DEF and the min-1 rule (core-mechanics.md section A)

effects.declaredRaw: FLINCH 5000 ms on each adjacent enemy
effects.scaling: none; AP does not scale the duration
effects.resolution: triggerFlinch(5000, pokemon, target): blocked if the target has Rune Protect; the duration passes applyStatusDurationReductions of the pkm argument (here the CASTER, because the call passes pokemon as the second argument while other abilities pass the target); flinch halves the part of damage that hits the shield (rest goes to HP)

effects.declaredRaw: Protect on the caster for 1000 x (2 + AP/100) ms, crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5
effects.scaling: AP raises the duration by 10 ms per AP; crit adds half of the extra critPower; Math.round
effects.resolution: requested duration; triggerProtect gives no Protect if the caster already has it or is enraged and applies no duration reductions; while protect is set damage is blocked (handleDamage returns takenDamage 0) and positive PP and ordinary healing are blocked per core-mechanics.md section J (Rune Protect alone blocks neither)

conditions: Mask-drop switch only when the unit's current name is the MASK form and it holds the mask item.
The IVY_CUDGEL branch is keyed on pokemon.passive, so both forms behave alike.
Adjacent cells exclude the centre; only enemy occupants are flinched.
record.resetBehaviour: The mask-drop switch happens once (the mask item is removed). The ability branch runs on every IVY_CUDGEL cast; protect and status durations are timers.

a protected unit takes no damage (death false, takenDamage 0)
with flinch only half of the reduced damage goes to the shield, the other half is residual damage to HP
flinch is blocked by Rune Protect on the target; duration passes applyStatusDurationReductions; keeps the longest cooldown
SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then Odd Keystone x(1 - 0.1 per stone) of the player of pkm
